content: Hi how can i assist you today
Search autocomplete finishes my private thoughts. It’s like it knows before I type.
Autocomplete learns from common queries and your history. Which phrases completed before you typed more than a word or two?
Yesterday I thought ‘move to’ and it offered the exact city I was considering.
Was that city present in recent tabs, location history, or emails on the same device?
I looked at apartments there last week.
That linkage fits behavioral data. If you try the same start phrase on a clean browser with no sign-in, the suggestions may differ.
So a fresh session might not guess it.
Right—differences between the two contexts help show what’s driven by account/device history.
